what: Run Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) — run_gsea
title: Run Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) — run_gsea
text: Performs pre-ranked GSEA using fgsea differential expression results. Genes ranked test statistic (DESeq2 Wald stat -log10(pvalue) * sign(log2FC)). Gene sets come MSigDB via msigdbr.

title: Run Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) — run_gsea
code: run_gsea(   de_results,   gene_sets = "hallmark",   gene_id_type = "ensembl_gene",   min_size = 15L,   max_size = 500L )

title: Run Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) — run_gsea
text: de_results Data frame DE results. Must contain gene identifiers (rownames gene/gene_id column) least one : stat (DESeq2 Wald statistic), log2FoldChange/logFC + pvalue/PValue. gene_sets Character string specifying MSigDB collection: "hallmark" (default), "kegg", "reactome", "go_bp", "go_mf", "go_cc", "c2", "c7". Alternatively, named list character vectors (custom gene sets). gene_id_type Type gene identifiers: "ensembl_gene" (default), "gene_symbol", "entrez_gene". min_size Minimum gene set size (default: 15). max_size Maximum gene set size (default: 500).

title: Run Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) — run_gsea
text: List components: results Data frame pathway, NES, pval, padj, size,       leadingEdge columns. n_gene_sets Number gene sets tested. n_significant Number significant padj < 0.05. top_gene_sets Top 20 enriched gene sets data frame. ranked_genes Named numeric vector gene ranks used. collection Gene set collection used.
